purpose: Blue reactor cores and cylindrical power feeds on the Authority Nexus; brass bands reuse the generated brass-ring texture
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production albedo texture for UV mapping a tall narrow cyan power cylinder on the Authority Nexus space station.

Generate a portrait 1:3 texture image, approximately 1024 by 3072 pixels. Fill the ENTIRE rectangular image edge to edge with a flat unwrapped sci-fi reactor surface. This is a MATERIAL TEXTURE, not a picture of a cylinder or an object.

Four slender vertical columns of blue-cyan energy cells run the full height. Deep cobalt glass and teal ceramic surfaces enclose pale electric cyan filaments, fine vertical conductive traces and bright slender cyan light strips. The cells have visible layered internal structure, subtle speckled energy, fine horizontal etched graduations, delicate segmented seams and tiny recessed contact pads. Use mostly luminous mid-blue and turquoise with a few narrow dark blue-gunmetal separators; keep the brightest pale cyan confined to the narrow filaments and indicators so the broad blue areas retain detailed texture. Several subtle horizontal service joints divide each column into long stacked cells. Elegant engineered containment hardware, precise restrained detail, slightly worn dark seam edges, clean surfaces.

Same hard-surface sci-fi game aesthetic as an ivory-and-brass wormhole station. Do not include gold rings or gold trim: these exist as separate geometry. This texture wraps around a cylinder, with the vertical axis of the image running up the cylinder. The left and right edges must meet seamlessly. Fine details should be crisp and readable on a narrow curved surface.

Perfectly straight-on flat orthographic material scan. Uniform neutral lighting, no perspective, no curved cylinder shading, no broad highlight gradient, no cast shadows, no blooming glow halos. Cyan illumination is in the material itself.
No text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, border, background, space, stars, station silhouette, separate objects, pipes or cables. Only the edge-to-edge flat blue energy-cell material.
